leads_close_date_range.name: leads_close_date_range
leads_close_date_range.value: "leads"."expected_close_date" IS NULL OR "leads"."expected_close_date" BETWEEN DATE '2000-01-01' AND DATE '2100-12-31'

messages_direction_shape.name: messages_direction_shape
messages_direction_shape.value: ("messages"."direction" = 'in' AND "messages"."delivery_state" = 'received' AND "messages"."sender_kind" = 'contact' AND "messages"."sender_user_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."external_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("messages"."direction" = 'out' AND "messages"."delivery_state" <> 'received' AND "messages"."sender_kind" <> 'contact' AND ("messages"."sender_kind" = 'user' OR "messages"."external_id" IS NOT NULL))

webhook_events_body_present.name: webhook_events_body_present
webhook_events_body_present.value: "webhook_events"."raw_body" IS NOT NULL OR "webhook_events"."body_purged_at" IS NOT NULL OR "webhook_events"."status" = 'rejected'
